children: COTI GC is generally available today as an all-purpose privacy solution, and the Enterprise Ethereum Alliance Privacy Working Group report cites it as the only privacy solution with general availability.

General availability changes GC from an announced solution into an accessible product that institutions can evaluate for privacy-related use cases. The EEA report's citation provides an external reference point for that availability and the institutional privacy demand it addresses.
The adoption pathway remains untested: actual use by institutions has yet to be shown, and any connection between product adoption and COTI token value accrual also remains unestablished.
Giving institutions everything they need to evaluate the best privacy solution for their needs. COTI GC is the all-purpose privacy solution - generally available today.

title: COTI: GC reaches general availability - 29 Aug 2026
